## 1. Executive Summary

At pack generation time (2026-02-22), the repo HEAD (`7e3dc059`) is **3 commits ahead of the currently deployed production SHA** (`d196ab66`). Production is live, healthy (status=ok, db=ok), and running version `crown-0.3.0` under tag `prod-deploy-2026-02-22-1415`. Of the 20 most recent `deploy-prod.yml` runs, 18 resulted in failure and only 2 in success — evidence of an extended deploy instability period resolved by PR #328. Branch protection on `main` enforces 7 required status checks with `strict=true` and `enforce_admins=true`, but requires **zero peer-review approvals**, meaning any passing-CI code can merge without human review. Secret scanning (gitleaks) reports 0 true-positive findings; custom pattern scanning identifies `DjangoSecretKeyLiteral` hits in two production workflow files and a `DatabaseUrl` hit in `backend/crown_api/settings.py`. These require human verification to determine whether they reference environment variables or embedded literals. The workflow surface is large (39 YAML files); one file (`stabilization-20260116-spine_crown-api-dev.yml`) has a duplicate `workflow_dispatch:` key. One job-level `if:` in `lockdown-golden-path-gate.yml` creates a conditional-skip on PR events. All Django migrations are applied with no unapplied migration drift. No tracked binaries were found.

## 4. Branch Protection

**Source:** `AUDIT_PACK_20260222_145853/05_BRANCH_PROTECTION_MAIN.json`

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Required status checks | 7 (see Section 3b) |
| Strict (branch must be up to date) | `true` |
| Dismiss stale reviews | `true` |
| Require code owner reviews | `false` |
| Require last push approval | `false` |
| **Required approving review count** | **0** |
| Required signatures (commit signing) | `false` |
| Enforce admins | `true` |
| Required linear history | `true` |
| Allow force pushes | `false` |
| Allow deletions | `false` |
| Block creations | `false` |
| Required conversation resolution | `false` |
| Lock branch | `false` |

**Findings:**

1. **Zero required peer reviews.** `required_approving_review_count: 0` means any code author who passes all 7 automated status checks can merge their own PR to `main` without any human review. Commit signing (`required_signatures`) is also disabled — commits cannot be cryptographically attributed.
2. **`enforce_admins: true`** is a positive control: administrators cannot bypass the branch protection rules.
3. **`required_linear_history: true`** enforces a clean, non-merge-commit history. Combined with `strict: true`, branches must be up-to-date before merge, preventing stale-base merges.
